# Published standard prices, 2026

The prices the checkout and the printed shop catalogue show for a standard parcel: the 2026
Nordpaket base rate for the weight bracket plus the fuel surcharge, in euros. Remote-area and
oversize surcharges come on top. Each price is what `quote()` returns as `totalCents` for a
small parcel (10 × 10 × 10 cm) at the bracket's upper weight.

| up to   | zone 1 | zone 2 | zone 3 | zone 4 (AT) |
|---------|-------:|-------:|-------:|------------:|
| 1 kg    |   5.32 |   5.86 |   6.41 |       12.92 |
| 2 kg    |   6.41 |   6.95 |   7.49 |       15.09 |
| 5 kg    |   7.49 |   8.25 |   8.90 |       17.26 |
| 10 kg   |   9.66 |  10.75 |  11.51 |       21.60 |
| 20 kg   |  14.00 |  15.19 |  16.17 |       29.19 |
| 31.5 kg |  18.34 |  19.43 |  20.51 |       37.87 |

Printed in the 2026/27 catalogue (October 2026): these prices must not change before the next
catalogue.
